name: zotero-modified
description: Unofficial Zotero 10 workflow tools: safe local curation, ethereal style metadata supported, and customized citation format.

interface.shortDescription: Zotero curation, status/rating conventions, and CSL tools
interface.longDescription: An unofficial extension of the upstream OpenAI Zotero workflow, compatible with Ethereal Style metadata, with enhanced features. It adds preview-first collection and item CRUD, collection snapshots, structured batch metadata updates, native colored tags, slash-prefixed status and rate conventions compatible with common Zotero table setups, and local CSL installation.
defaultPrompt: create and curate a collection with a preview before every write
modify item metadata in the collection using ethereal style format
write and install a CSL template for Zotero Word integration
